- enum class `MouseCursor` — eacp::Graphics — View.h:46 — The shape the pointer takes over a view.
  - `Default` = 0 — The arrow. What a view has until it says otherwise.
  - `IBeam` = 1 — Over text that can be selected.
  - `PointingHand` = 2 — Over something clickable that is not a control — a link.
  - `ResizeLeftRight` = 3 — Over a vertical splitter, so a draggable divider reads as draggable before anyone tries dragging it.
  - `ResizeUpDown` = 4 — Over a horizontal splitter.
  - `Crosshair` = 5 — Over a horizontal splitter.
